title: Parish and Will
author: Wendell Oyelaran
blurb: Silas Almeida, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
